answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The ember cap is enforced at intake and zephyr makes public the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a river tag. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
